title: Updating Clinical Risk Stratification Models Using Rank-Based Compatibility: Approaches for Evaluating and Optimizing Clinician-Model Team Performance
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel rank-based compatibility measure and a new loss function for updating clinical machine learning models, and evaluates it on a benchmark dataset (MIMIC-III). While the topic of AI in healthcare has ethical implications, the paper focuses on technical metrics (discriminative performance, compatibility) and model optimization, not on evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core component.
